headline: ShelfMitra's Bengali beta and Kolkata office make it the top threat [ShelfMitra-3-4][ShelfMitra-3-5]
tl_dr: ShelfMitra added Bengali language support in beta on 2026-10-20 and opened a Kolkata office in Salt Lake Sector V to serve West Bengal retailers [ShelfMitra-3-4][ShelfMitra-3-5].
Its 12 Field Sales Executive, 2 Territory Sales Manager and 1 Regional Sales Head roles in Kolkata are unchanged from week 2 [ShelfMitra-3-6][ShelfMitra-3-7][ShelfMitra-3-8].
StockSathi's app-store rating fell from 4.3 to 3.9 across 18,665 reviews, with duplicate UPI Udhaar reminders as the top complaint [StockSathi-3-6].
BahiBook opened a Product Manager role for GST e-invoicing in Pune that was not on its week 2 careers page; its prices are unchanged [BahiBook-3-3][BahiBook-3-1].
StockSathi shipped a 2026-10-21 fix for duplicate UPI Udhaar reminders; its prices and hiring are unchanged [StockSathi-3-2][StockSathi-3-1][StockSathi-3-3].
since_last_week: StockSathi's threat falls from high in the week 2 brief to low; its Pro price stays at ₹699 and hiring is unchanged [StockSathi-3-1][StockSathi-3-3].
StockSathi's app-store rating fell from 4.3 in week 2 to 3.9 in week 3 [StockSathi-3-6].
ShelfMitra's threat stays high; the Bengali beta and the Kolkata office are new this week [ShelfMitra-3-4][ShelfMitra-3-5].
BahiBook's threat rises from low in the week 2 brief to medium on a new GST e-invoicing Product Manager opening in Pune [BahiBook-3-3].
BahiBook's Solo and Plus prices are unchanged from week 2 [BahiBook-3-1].

threats.rationale: ShelfMitra launched Bengali language support in beta [ShelfMitra-3-4] and opened a Kolkata office to serve West Bengal retailers [ShelfMitra-3-5], both new, high-impact moves into KiranaCloud's home market. The Kolkata sales hiring [ShelfMitra-3-6][ShelfMitra-3-7][ShelfMitra-3-8] is unchanged from week 2 and is context only, not new evidence.

BahiBook opened a Product Manager role for GST e-invoicing in Pune that was not on the week 2 page [BahiBook-3-3], a single opening with no shipped feature yet. Its Devanagari ledger search fix is minor [BahiBook-3-2], its Customer Support opening is unchanged [BahiBook-3-4], and its pricing is unchanged [BahiBook-3-1].

Its only new credible item is a minor UPI Udhaar reminder fix [StockSathi-3-2], and its app-store rating fell from 4.3 to 3.9 on the same reminder complaints [StockSathi-3-6]. Pricing and hiring are unchanged [StockSathi-3-1][StockSathi-3-3], and the Mysuru meetup is a low-impact context item [StockSathi-3-5].

recommendations.action: Prioritise retention calls to high-value Kolkata stores before ShelfMitra's 15 open Kolkata sales roles reach them, given its Bengali beta and new office.
Assess whether KiranaCloud needs Bengali language support for Kolkata stores this month, since ShelfMitra's Bengali beta is already live.
Watch StockSathi's rating and whether its 2026-10-21 UPI Udhaar reminder fix reverses the complaints before changing any plan.

watchlist: BahiBook's new GST e-invoicing Product Manager role in Pune is a single opening that may point to a future feature; nothing has shipped [BahiBook-3-3].
StockSathi's blog reports about 80 store owners at a Mysuru kirana owners' feedback meetup (credibility 0.6) [StockSathi-3-5].
BahiBook's Devanagari ledger search fix dated 2026-10-22 is minor and low impact [BahiBook-3-2].
discounted_claims: StockSathi-3-4: unverified Startup Gupshup blog claim, citing unnamed sources, that a large e-commerce player is acquiring StockSathi; no company has confirmed it (credibility 0.2).
